title: Modified TruSeq Small RNA Library Prep using Randomized 4N Adapters: In house 4N Protocol D
protocol: Dilute 3’ adapter to 4 µM in water.
Dilute 5’ adapter to 10 µM in water.
Dilute 50% PEG to 15% PEG by adding water.
Aliquot 10 μL of 15% PEG to PCR tube.
Dry aliquoted 15% PEG until it forms a pellet.
Store the dried PEG pellet in dark conditions.
Add 1 μL of 4 μM 3’-4N adapter to each tube.
Add 5 μL of each RNA sample.
Immediately place on ice for 2 minutes.
Prepare Ligation Master Mix by mixing Ligation Buffer (HML), RNase Inhibitor, and T4 RNA Ligase 2, Deletion Mutant in a total volume of 4 μL per sample.
Add 4 μL of the prepared Ligation Master Mix to each tube.
Add 1 µg of E. coli SSBP to each tube.
Prepare a master mix by adding 1.1 x N (N = number of samples) 10 µM 5’-4N adapter to separate PCR tube.
Add 1.1 x N (N = number of samples) 10 mM ATP to the RNA 5’ Adapter PCR Tube.
Add 1.1 x N (N = number of samples) T4 RNA Ligase to the RNA 5’ and ATP PCR Tube.
Add 3 µL of the master mix to each sample (reaction from step 17).
Concentrate samples down from 14 µL to 6 µL.
Add 1 µL of RNA RT Primer to each tube.
Add 5.5 µL of RT Master Mix to each sample.
Prepare PCR Master Mix using Ultra Pure Water, PCR Mix, and RNA PCR Primer as specified volumes.
Add 35.5 µL of PCR Master Mix to each tube.
Add 2 µL of unique PCR Primer Index to each tube.
Gently mix the samples after adding PCR Primer Index.
Centrifuge the samples after adding PCR Primer Index.
PCR Program: Incubate at 98°C for 30 seconds.
